formula_checks.what_the_code_actually_does: incomeBearingClassOf = nameEvidence (src/domain/assets/index.ts:380-382 → Calculation Module code/engines/holding-class.ts nameEvidence). The registries are explicit there: MONEY_MARKET_TICKERS, TBILL_ETF_TICKERS, CRYPTO_TICKERS, COMMODITY_TICKERS; COMPANY_WORDS (corp|inc|ltd|plc|mining|miners|resources|company) blocks BOTH commodity words and bond words.
formula_checks.card_text_says: Lists the order but not the ticker lists, and gives the company-name exception only for commodity words.

formula_checks.plain_example: 'Treasury Wine Estates Ltd': card as written → Bonds & CDs; code → no class (null), as DEC-2747d rules. Card should name the company test for bond words and the ticker lists.

formula_checks.what_the_code_actually_does: wrapperAccount default branch returns {kind:'brokerage', tax_bucket:'TAXABLE'} for anything else or nothing (src/domain/assets/index.ts:455).
formula_checks.card_text_says: Same: anything else, or nothing chosen → brokerage, taxable.
formula_checks.plain_example: Add by hand with no tax choice → 'Vanguard Brokerage', taxable. Should it stay 'tax not entered' instead? DEC-2441 lists the by-hand form's 401(k)/IRA choice as not built.

formula_checks.what_the_code_actually_does: Standalone branch (no household handed in, src/domain/assets/index.ts:651-653): rental only if a handed-in rent entry names it, else the STORED re_use ?? 'primary' — even when the rent entries were handed in and none names it. Household branch (index.ts:655-656) reads propertyUseMap, which, told the entries, turns a stored 'rental' with no entry into a second home (index.ts:801).
formula_checks.card_text_says: Same two branches as the code.
formula_checks.plain_example: One house stored re_use 'rental', rent entries handed in = [] : realEstateUseOf(house, undefined, []) → 'rental'; with the household, propertyUseMap → 'secondary'. Should be 'secondary' both ways (DEC-3035p: handed the rent entries, rental only when an entry names it). Reach is small: the function has no live caller.

formula_checks.what_the_code_actually_does: Σ (a.balance || 0) (src/domain/assets/index.ts:954). A null balance adds 0, which is the same number as leaving it out; the account is named by the amber box, dataGaps 'no-balance' (src/domain/gaps/index.ts:166). totalAssets has no production caller; the screen's What you own is buildAssetsState (index.ts:2213), which has no null guard (undefined → NaN).
formula_checks.card_text_says: Every account's balance added up; a missing balance counts as zero.
formula_checks.plain_example: $8,450.25 + $17,600.50 + Linked savings (no value) → $26,050.75 and the amber box 'Linked savings has no balance' — exactly what DEC-3279e asks. DEC-2747f is his 'no' to adding a count of missing accounts to this total; the auditor read it as the opposite. The card's words 'counts as zero' should say 'is left out' to match DEC-3279e. Real adjacent defect: buildAssetsState with an undefined balance → NaN (see screen check MK-NW-M-004).

formula_checks.what_the_code_actually_does: Σ over accounts of breakdown cash, else whole balance when class is cash, else 0; a missing balance adds 0 via (a.balance || 0) (src/domain/assets/index.ts:990-995). It does not go through sumWhere, so no missing count; the amber box still names the account (gaps/index.ts:166).
formula_checks.plain_example: Checking $3,200 + a linked savings with no balance → $3,200 and the months-covered line reads '$3,200 cash ÷ …' with no note on that line (the box higher up names the account). DEC-3279e names sumWhere/investableAssets/dataGaps, not cashTotal: must the cash line itself say an account was left out?
